continuations.note: Chapter 6 Exercises continue with Exercises 15-21 and finish before Problems on PDF 292.
Theorem 2.1 is stated on PDF 299; its proof begins on PDF 300 and continues in the next batch.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 有限维联合分布
key_objects.name_en: finite-dimensional joint distribution of Brownian motion
key_objects.description: Calculate the joint probability distribution measure of (B_{t1},...,B_{tk}); hint: use the previous chapter’s Gaussian vector result.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian filtration 的右连续性
key_objects.name_en: right-continuity of the Brownian filtration

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian filtration 的左连续性
key_objects.name_en: left-continuity of the Brownian filtration
key_objects.description: For t>0 prove A_t=A_{t-}, where A_{t-} is generated by all A_s with s<t; first consider cylindrical sets.

key_objects.name_zh: 停止时刻与 stopped process 的可测性
key_objects.name_en: measurability of a stopping time and its stopped process
key_objects.description: Show (a) σ is A_σ-measurable; (b) B_σ is A_σ-measurable; (c) A_σ is the σ-algebra determined by the stopped process B̂_t=B_{t∧σ}.

key_objects.name_zh: 球面平均值性质推出调和性
key_objects.name_en: mean-value property on spheres implies harmonicity
key_objects.description: For bounded Borel u on bounded open R satisfying the spherical mean-value property: derive the ball-average formula and conclude continuity and harmonicity.

key_objects.name_zh: Lipschitz 边界蕴含 outside cone condition
key_objects.name_en: Lipschitz boundary implies the outside cone condition
key_objects.description: Verify that a bounded open set with Lipschitz boundary satisfies the outside cone condition; hence C^1 domains do as well and the Dirichlet problem is uniquely solvable.

key_objects.name_zh: 嵌套区域的 harmonic measure 复合公式
key_objects.name_en: composition formula for harmonic measures of nested domains
key_objects.description: For R1⊂R2 and x∈R1, prove μ_2^x=∫_{∂R1} μ_2^y dμ_1^x, equivalently on every Borel E⊂∂R2.

key_objects.name_zh: Kolmogorov 连续性定理型修正
key_objects.name_en: Kolmogorov-type continuity theorem
key_objects.description: If ||F_{t1}-F_{t2}||_{L^p}≤c|t1-t2|^α with α>1/p, construct a version F̃_t with almost-everywhere continuous sample paths, Hölder of every order γ<α-1/p.

key_objects.name_zh: 一般 iid 向量随机游走的 Donsker 不变性原理
key_objects.name_en: Donsker invariance principle for general iid vector increments
key_objects.description: For iid square-integrable R^d-valued mean-zero variables with identity covariance, prove tightness of the induced path measures and conclude weak convergence to Wiener measure.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 的 Hilbert 空间构造
key_objects.name_en: Hilbert-space construction of Brownian motion
key_objects.description: Use a unitary map U:L^2([0,∞))→H and B_t=U(χ_{[0,t]}) to construct Brownian motion after applying the continuity correction.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 的维数相关常返与暂留
key_objects.name_en: dimension-dependent recurrence and transience of Brownian motion
key_objects.description: Establish: point recurrence in d=1; points are polar for d≥2; neighborhood recurrence in d=2; transience in d≥3.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 的重对数律
key_objects.name_en: law of the iterated logarithm for Brownian motion
key_objects.description: State the limsup/liminf oscillation law as t→∞ and, via time inversion, as t→0.

key_objects.name_zh: Dirichlet 边界正则性的逆命题
key_objects.name_en: converse regularity criterion for the Dirichlet problem
key_objects.description: For d≥2, prove that if every continuous boundary datum is attained continuously at y, then y is a regular boundary point.

key_objects.name_zh: Lebesgue thorn 的非正则边界点
key_objects.name_en: Lebesgue thorn as a non-regular boundary point
key_objects.description: Construct a cusp-shaped removed set E in a ball in R^d, d≥3, for which sufficiently rapid decay of f near 0 makes the origin a non-regular boundary point.

key_objects.name_zh: 第 7 章：多复变函数初窥
key_objects.name_en: Chapter 7: A Glimpse into Several Complex Variables
key_objects.description: Introduces phenomena that differ sharply from one-variable complex analysis: automatic continuation, tangential Cauchy-Riemann operators, and complex convexity of domain boundaries.

key_objects.name_zh: 多圆盘 P_r(z0)
key_objects.name_en: polydisc P_r(z0)

key_objects.name_zh: 边界圆周乘积 C_r(z0)
key_objects.name_en: product of boundary circles C_r(z0)

key_objects.name_zh: C^n 中全纯函数的四个等价刻画
key_objects.name_en: four equivalent characterizations of holomorphic functions in C^n
key_objects.description: For continuous f on an open set Ω: distributional Cauchy-Riemann equations; separate one-variable analyticity; the polydisc Cauchy integral formula; and local absolutely/uniformly convergent power series are equivalent.

key_objects.name_zh: 多复变 Cauchy-Riemann 方程
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy-Riemann equations in several variables

key_objects.name_zh: 多圆盘上的 Cauchy 积分公式
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy integral representation on a polydisc

key_objects.name_zh: 全纯性的四个刻画等价
key_objects.name_en: equivalence of the four holomorphicity conditions
key_objects.statement: For a continuous function f on an open set Ω⊂C^n, conditions (i)-(iv) given above are equivalent.

key_objects.name_zh: 多变量幂级数的 Cauchy 系数公式
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy coefficient formula for several-variable power series

key_objects.name_zh: 分布意义 Cauchy-Riemann 方程的正则化
key_objects.name_en: regularization from distributional Cauchy-Riemann equations
key_objects.description: A locally integrable f satisfying ∂̄f=0 distributionally can be corrected on a null set to become continuous, hence holomorphic by Proposition 1.1.

key_objects.name_zh: 多复变解析恒等定理
key_objects.name_en: identity principle in several complex variables
key_objects.statement: If holomorphic f and g on a region Ω agree near one point, then they agree throughout Ω.

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 环域自动延拓定理
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs extension from a spherical shell
key_objects.statement: If F is holomorphic on Ω={z∈C^n:ρ<|z|<1}, n≥2, then F extends holomorphically to the whole unit ball.

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 基本延拓构造中的 K1 与 K2
key_objects.name_en: the K1/K2 configuration in the basic Hartogs extension
key_objects.description: In C^2, K1={|z1|≤a, |z2|=b1} and K2={|z1|=a, b2≤|z2|≤b1}; their union controls extension to the product region.

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 的乘积区域延拓引理
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs product-region extension lemma
key_objects.statement: If F is holomorphic in a region O containing K1∪K2, then F extends holomorphically to an open set Õ containing {|z1|≤a, b2≤|z2|≤b1}.

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 延拓中的阴影乘积区域
key_objects.name_en: shaded product region in the Hartogs extension lemma

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 延拓积分 I(z1,z2)
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs extension integral I(z1,z2)
